cli.description: A OAI-PMH Harvester using ListIdentifiers and GetRecord verbs.
cli.help_auto: Automatic mode to harvest the period from from-date to today. Automatically adjusts the data in the configuration file.
cli.help_batchsize: Split output into part_XXXX subfolders of this many files (default: no subfolders)
cli.help_cleanup_on_empty: Ausgabeordner löschen wenn keine Datensätze geharvestet wurden.
cli.help_conf: Relative or absolute path to the YAML configuration file
cli.help_deleted: How to handle deleted records: keep (default), skip, or move to _deleted/ folder
cli.help_fromdate: ISO8601 timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD), harvesting from this date onwards
cli.help_gentle: Conservative mode for sensitive endpoints: 1 thread, 30s timeout, 20s rate limit (all overridable)
cli.help_gentle_conf: Conservative mode (see default command). A 'gentle' key in the YAML file takes precedence.
cli.help_maxtimeout: Hard ceiling for adaptive timeout in seconds (default: 120)
cli.help_no_log: Kein Logfile anlegen (sinnvoll für Cron-Betrieb mit externem Logging).
cli.help_resumptiontoken: Resume harvesting with resumptionToken. Requires -d option.
cli.help_set: Set(s) on the OAI interface, separated by ',' or '/' symbol
cli.help_sort_invalid: Move records without element content below <metadata> to _invalid/
cli.help_summary: Write a structured XML run summary (_ometha_<datengeber>_summary.xml)
cli.help_timeout: Timeout between requests in seconds (default: 20, or 30 in --gentle mode)
cli.help_untildate: ISO8601 timestamp (YYYY-MM-DD), harvesting until this date
cli.invalid_date: {value} ist kein valides Datum. Bitte ISO8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) oder z.B. '20m', '6h', '1d' verwenden.
